senses.gloss: m. (פָּרַךְ; cmp. פֶּרֶק) [limb,] twig with grapes.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:3">Ukts. I, 3</cite> <he>יד הפ׳</he> the handle (stem) of a vine.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:16">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>פ׳ של ענבים</he>; a. e.—Pl. <he>פַּרְכִּילִים</he>.

<cite ref="Beitzah 30b">Bets. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 10a:15">Succ. 10ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>פּרְכִּילֵי ענבים</he> (<cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 1:7">Tosef. ib. I, 7</cite> <he>אשכולות של ענבים</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:6:5">Y. Bicc. I, 64ᵇ</cite> top <he>פַּרְכִּירֵי ענבים</he>.
